name: AbyM Consent Banner for Digital Anumati
author: digitalanumati

sections.description:
AbyM Consent Banner for Digital Anumati connects your WordPress site to Digital Anumati’s consent banner service a Consent Manager built for India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023) and the DPDP Rules 2025.

Under the DPDP Act, businesses (“data fiduciaries”) that collect personal data from users (“data principals”) through their website need to provide appropriate notice, obtain valid consent where required, and maintain consent records. This plugin helps add the Digital Anumati consent banner to a WordPress site without requiring custom code.

The plugin is designed for businesses working on DPDP Act compliance and provides the website consent-banner integration through the Digital Anumati Consent Manager.

Why use this plugin

Purpose-built for the DPDP Act the Digital Anumati consent banner and Consent Manager are designed around India’s DPDP requirements.

No-code setup add your Digital Anumati scripts from Settings > Digital Anumati.

Simple WordPress integration the plugin adds the configured Digital Anumati scripts to the appropriate locations on your website.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Digital Anumati Consent Service to display and manage the consent banner.

Service URL: https://consent.digitalanumati.com/

The plugin may load the following JavaScript from Digital Anumati:

https://consent.digitalanumati.com/anumati-dpdp-consent-v1.js

When the integration is configured and a visitor opens the website, the visitor’s browser may request resources from Digital Anumati. Information transmitted to the service may include the website domain, browser/device information, IP address, referrer information, consent preferences, and other information processed by the Digital Anumati service.

An active Digital Anumati account may be required to configure and use the service.

For more information, please review:

Digital Anumati Terms of Service

Digital Anumati Privacy Policy

Video Tutorial

This video demonstrates plugin installation, activation, Site Key configuration, saving the settings, and verifying the Digital Anumati consent banner on a WordPress website.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/abym-consent-banner-digital-anumati/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Digital Anumati.
  4. Enter the Site Key and/or paste the head/body script snippets supplied by Digital Anumati, according to your Digital Anumati account configuration.
  5. Save the settings.
  6. Visit the front end of your website and verify that the Digital Anumati consent banner is displayed.

An active Digital Anumati account is required.

sections.faq:
What is a DPDP consent banner?

A DPDP consent banner is a website notice that informs visitors about personal data processing and provides a mechanism for obtaining consent where consent is required under applicable privacy requirements.

Do Indian websites need a consent banner under the DPDP Act?

Requirements depend on the organization, the processing activities, the personal data involved, and applicable exemptions and obligations. Organizations should assess their specific obligations under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act and applicable rules and seek professional compliance advice where appropriate.

What is a Consent Manager under the DPDP Act?

A Consent Manager is an entity that provides an interface through which data principals can give, manage, review, and withdraw consent. Digital Anumati provides a Consent Manager service, and this plugin connects a WordPress website to that service.

Do I need a Digital Anumati account?

Yes. This plugin connects your WordPress website to the Digital Anumati service. An active Digital Anumati account is required to obtain the configuration information used by the plugin.

Create or access your Digital Anumati account

Is this plugin only for the DPDP Act?

This plugin is specifically designed to integrate a WordPress website with the Digital Anumati Consent Manager for India’s DPDP requirements. It does not by itself provide compliance with other countries’ privacy laws.

What is a consent notice under the DPDP Act?

A consent notice provides information about the personal data being processed and the purpose for which it is processed before or when consent is requested, where applicable. The Digital Anumati banner can present the configured notice and consent experience on the website.

Can users withdraw consent after accepting the banner?

The Digital Anumati Consent Manager provides functionality for managing and withdrawing consent. The availability and behavior of specific consent options depend on the Digital Anumati configuration.

What happens if my site isn’t DPDP compliant?

This plugin provides the website consent-banner integration only. It does not by itself make a business fully compliant with the DPDP Act or other applicable laws. Organizations should assess their complete privacy and data-protection obligations and obtain professional compliance advice where appropriate.

Where do I configure the plugin?

After activating the plugin, go to Settings > Digital Anumati in your WordPress admin area.
